resources.string: Your steps are clearing the fog
Too fast for the mist: it only clears under your own steam
Made by Tjerk at Potloodgum, a one-person studio in Leeuwarden. Fixing the world in tiny steps.
I wanted a reason to walk down streets I had never been down. Misty Steps turns your own neighbourhood into a map to uncover, one step (or pedal, or push) at a time.
No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Your trails never leave your phone.
If it gets you out the door, you can buy me a coffee. It keeps the mist drifting.
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors. Borders and streets from OpenStreetMap\'s Nominatim and Overpass services.
